sentences: The translator accepts FP32 nearest-even with FP16/64 nearest-even or toward-zero and writes the same per-invocation state as `s_setreg_imm32_b32`.
AMD RDNA2 ISA tables 15 and 24; synthetic positive and negative halfway-neighbour conversions in `test_scalar_noop_waitcnt.py` check both modes in one shader.
